en.headline: Hang Seng Tech Index to expand to 50 stocks in December
en.dek: Hang Seng Indexes Company said each proposal in its consultation drew support from more than 80 per cent of respondents.
body: Hang Seng Indexes Company said on Wednesday it would adopt most of its proposed changes to the Hang Seng TECH Index after each suggestion won support from more than 80 per cent of responding organisations.

The number of constituents will rise from 30 to 50. Forty will be chosen by market value and the remaining 10 by revenue growth over the past 12 months, a route aimed at companies with high growth potential, product director Lam Wing-ting said. Constituent changes will be announced in the 20 November quarterly review and take effect on 7 December.

The company adjusted the dual selection mechanism after the consultation. A stock that is not already a constituent must have average daily turnover of at least 100 million dollars over the past three months. Stocks entering through the revenue-growth group must also have recorded at least 500 million dollars in annual revenue in each of the two latest financial years.

Individual weight caps stay at 8 per cent for ordinary constituents and 4 per cent for foreign companies. Hang Seng Indexes said advanced hardware names would rise from seven to 18, information-technology stocks to 26, and the industrial sector, previously absent, could take up to five places.

zh.headline: 科指成份股增至50隻 12月7日生效
zh.dek: 恒指公司公布諮詢結果，每項建議均獲逾八成回應單位支持，將採納大部分修訂，並於11月20日季檢公布成份股變動。
body: 恒生指數公司星期三公布恒生科技指數編算方法諮詢結果，指每項建議均獲得逾八成回應單位支持，故將採納大部分建議。
成份股數目將由30隻增至50隻。產品總監林穎婷表示，首40隻按市值排名挑選，其餘10隻按過去12個月收入增長排名選出，以吸納高增長潛力企業。成份股變動將於11月20日季檢公布，12月7日正式生效。
諮詢後，雙組別選股機制有所調整。非現有成份股須符合過去三個月日均成交額最少1億元的要求；按收入增長入選的股份，則須於最近連續兩個財政年度各錄得最少5億元年收入。
個股權重上限維持不變，一般成份股上限為8%，外國公司上限為4%。恒指公司指，先進硬件成份股將由7隻增至18隻，資訊科技業增至26隻，過往沒有納入的工業類別亦可最多佔5隻。
